name: mujoco_hopper_v0_vectorized_wall_clock
description: Canonical MuJoCo Hopper continuous-control benchmark using a fixed wall-clock training window for vectorized autoresearch candidates.
notes: Hopper is a standard MuJoCo locomotion benchmark with three torque-controlled hinges.
This benchmark fixes the training budget by wall-clock time rather than episode count.
train_episodes is a high safety cap; the intended budget is train_seconds.
Use seed_trainable_vectorized.py so candidate code can mutate vector env count, batch size, update cadence, and rendering cadence to improve utilization.
